recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast mixed-media composition featuring a central female figure in a pinstriped jacket with arms raised, surrounded by expressive, painterly depictions of barking dogs. The style blends photographic elements with raw, gestural oil pastel strokes and vibrant, saturated color overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by dynamic, diagonal canine forms
Contrast between photographic realism and abstract painterly textures
Rhythmic repetition of pinstripe patterns against organic animal shapes
Tension between dark negative space and bright, saturated primary accents
coreInvariants: Pinstripe texture on the central figure's garment
High-contrast facial lighting with saturated lip color
Hand-drawn gestural outlines around photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central female figure dominates the upper two-thirds; dogs occupy the foreground and midground in a circular arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, high-contrast face of the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Upward from the red dog in the lower left, following the pinstripe lines to the face, then out to the raised arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/navy void in the upper left corner providing breathing room for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and black for background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale skin tones for the central figure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated primary red and electric blue used for gestural highlights and canine forms.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with localized high-saturation pops against a dark, desaturated base.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary accents (Red, Blue, Yellow) on dark grounds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist and title for minimalist cohesion.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif structure and sharp terminals.
Provides the necessary stroke contrast and elegant slant.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a mixed-media collage. Center a woman in a black and white pinstripe blazer with arms raised and mouth open in a shout. Surround her with expressionist, painterly dogs in red, blue, and white with aggressive, barking expressions. Use heavy oil pastel textures and a dark navy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two strings of text in a red, high-contrast italic serif font at the very top edge, one aligned left and one aligned right, leaving a gap in the center.

verificationChecks: Are the dogs rendered with painterly, gestural strokes?
Is the text a saturated red serif?
Is the background a dark, near-black void?

adjustableVariables: Degree of photographic vs. painterly blend
Font weight of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the woman
Exact placement of canine ears and snouts
postGenerationChecks: Check for pinstripe clarity on the jacket
Ensure the red dog is the primary foreground accent
Verify the text is positioned at the extreme top margin
Confirm the background is sufficiently dark to make the white skin pop
recipe.reuseFormula: Mixed-media collage + pinstripe texture + gestural oil pastel animals + high-contrast serif typography in primary red.
